subject: Chemistry
scope: Eight original single-fact exam-theory Chemistry RP1–RP3 and practical analysis flashcards. No laboratory methods or instructions.
notes: Supports student understanding of uncertainties, evaluation and experimental variables. Taught AS mock only; Task 1 is not certified complete.

cards.front: What is a systematic error in experimental measurements?
cards.back: A consistent bias that shifts measurements in the same direction.
accept: A consistent bias that shifts measurements in the same direction.
An error which consistently makes values too high or too low.
A repeatable bias affecting accuracy.
A consistent measurement bias.
reject: Unpredictable scatter between readings.
An error that always disappears with repeats.
A random variation with no consistent direction.
